ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The souls of our greatest heroes cast light enough to drive away the darkness. We must preserve them at any cost.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The galaxy was once ours to rule. The artefacts of our kind found here could serve as a reminder of what we had before the fall.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: We walk the paths of the Aspect Warriors to focus our war spirit. Without such focus, our kind would be doomed to relive the fall.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The threads of fate entwine to this world. We know not where this path will lead.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Such a treasure as this can naught but aid us in our purpose in a galaxy that has grown hostile to our presence.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: There are precious few of our kind left in the galaxy. Perhaps some clue to our future lies within that ancient wreckage.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: We cannot let the bones of St. Sarissa fall into the hands of corruption. Make safe her sanctuary, Brothers!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Lord Halovar has sworn compliance and declared his allegiance to the Imperium. He now requires our aid in safely escaping the darkness.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: This ancient edifice is a testament to the will of mankind. With its might we shall drive back the darkness.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The artefacts that reside within that vault were crafted by the machine priests of old. They must be rescued.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Come, Brothers! The Emperor has granted us a mighty boon. We must but take the planet below and the prize shall be ours!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The light of the Astronomican is faint in this far-flung sector. Once activated, this beacon will guide us to safety.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: 'ey Boss! Dus planet's got loads o' Boyz just rarin' to get inta' the action!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Oi! Down dere is mobs of 'umies just waitin' ter get their 'eads smashed in! Let's get em!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Down on 'at one dere be miles an' miles o' nuthin! It's perfect fer speedin'! Go get da' trukks!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: We be needin' fuel fer da trukks so we'z can drive fasta ta find more fuel fer da trukks, so we'z can drive fasta.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Dat scrap world's gots lots a good gubbin's and wotnots fer da mekboyz ta build more stompas wif.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Dis 'ere world is full o' dem trukks, wagons, an' tanks da 'umies make, just layin' dere fer da takin'!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: For 10.000 years, I have spilled the blood of my enemies. I believe I have finally found a foe truly worthy of my blade!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The babbling of a thousand mystics tells me that the Daemon, Urzrahk G'hor is bound within that blade. His fury shall be mine!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: Iratio Acrior has slept for millennia, but the embers of its war spirit yet burn. I shall unleash its fury upon the pawns of the False Emperor.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The teeming masses of this world have but one worth. Their skulls shall adorn the fortress of the Blood God.

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The greatest warriors wield weapons wrought in the fires of a hellforge. On the world below, I shall forge my rage into a blade of purest hate!

ContainedObjects.Name: Card
ContainedObjects.Description: The population of this world is ripe for slaughter. Their blood shall flow like a river to the foot of Khorne's throne.
